title: Distribution of polychlorinated organic by-products during the hydrolytic oxidation of chlorinated volatile organic pollutants over Pd–Ni-based catalysts
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3138-3151
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08447D, Paper

Yuqing Li, Bisi Lv, Na Li, Wenjie Song, Jiahui Zhou, Caifei Ni, Wenlong Fu, Zhen Han
Hydrolysis oxidation for CVOCs degradation significantly inhibits chlorinated organic by-product formation. The catalyst's hydrolysis oxidation activity is mainly co-regulated by its surface acidity, water existence form, and redox properties.
